draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Following up on my note from earlier this week — you've got your first project created, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding a couple of tasks to that project is usually the natural next step. If it'd help to have a second set of hands in there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a quick 15-minute call this week be useful? Happy to walk through whatever's most relevant to how your team works.

Best,
Priya
